name: cloudflare
summary: Put the store's rate limits, geo blocks, custom rules and managed rulesets on its Cloudflare zone.

env.name: CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID
env.comment: The zone's ID (Cloudflare dashboard, the domain's Overview page, API section)

env.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
env.comment: An API token scoped to that zone only, with Zone › Zone › Read and Zone › Zone WAF › Edit

next: Create the API token in the Cloudflare dashboard (My Profile, API Tokens) with two permissions on this zone only: Zone › Zone › Read and Zone › Zone WAF › Edit.
Behind Cloudflare every request reaches the API from an edge address: set http.trustProxy: true so the in-process rate limiter keys on the client, not on the edge.
Run nymbal security:plan to see the rules, then nymbal security:apply to put them on the zone; nymbal security:drift reports a dashboard edit.
